title: Practical: UniMart Full-Stack Monolith Labs
lead: Covers the ten UniMart lab guides as one end-to-end picture: ER design and the layered monolith, React + TypeScript frontend, Spring Boot MVC backend, MySQL, environment configuration and secrets, Git and pull requests, CRUD APIs with Postman tests, frontend features with RTK Query, full-stack integration and debugging, and Docker / GitHub Actions deployment. Explains what each lab teaches architecturally. No prior attendance needed.
